title: 第三百四十五章 殊死拼杀第三百四十四章 暗夜袭杀
lines: 第两百四十五章：殊死拼杀
长安宁静的夜，突然被一阵巨响打破。在元气贯注双目之后，叶重也是看清了夜色中射来的是什么东西。
那是数十支手指粗，一尺多长，通体漆黑做了防反光处理，流线型的三棱破风锥。这造型奇特的破风锥设计精良，打造的手艺更是高明至极，用强劲机括射出的破风锥速度极快，飞行之时居然不带半点儿声响。
要不是进入武王境界，已经初步有了灵识，叶重根本察觉不到这玩意的靠近。
“嘿”的吐了一口气，元气透体而发，一层柔韧致密的罡气覆盖全身，叶重拍出两掌朝几支距离自己只有不到丈许的破风锥迎了上去。碎山掌瞬间发动，无形的空气漩涡席卷而出，空气中立刻响起了诡异的风啸声。
裂帛声响起，叶重拍出的两道漩涡气劲被破风锥轻松刺穿，他放出体外一丈左右的护身罡气，更是被破风锥轻轻松松的击破。不仅如此，那破风锥更是逆着叶重的罡气，速度骤然增加了三成，快若闪电般射了下来。
“这玩意可破罡气！”，双眸中血光一旋，叶重骤然看清了破风锥上面雕刻的细小符箓“破风符”这本来是用在飞剑之类的元器上，专门用来破开高空天然罡风，增加飞剑飞行速度的符箓，用来武者的护身罡气，居然也有奇效。
此刻，叶重更看清了这些破风锥尖端处，一点若有若无的黑芒。破风锥前面这一点最锋利的尖端，居然是用罕见的‘冥风铁’打造。这种千年玄铁吸纳了百年地下阴冥之气才能产生的奇特金属，也专破武者的罡气。
怪叫一声，叶重哪里还敢硬抗，随后只见叶重抱着脑袋，身体骤然一缩，变成了一个不到两尺大的肉球，滴溜溜的带着一阵风声，紧贴着地面一通赖驴打滚翻滚了出去。密集的‘嗤嗤’声不断响起，数十支破风锥紧贴着叶重的身体射在了地上，在地面上射出了数十个深不见底的小窟窿。
一通乱翻，叶重冲到了朱易三人所在的马车边，飞起一脚将马车朝小巷入口处踢出。
庞大的元气爆发，沉重的马车‘呼’的一声急退十几丈，近百支破风锥乱杂杂的射下来，地上又被射出了一大片密集的小窟窿。一声巨响，马车炸开，朱易、苏定、张松三人从粉碎的车厢里冲了出来。
经验老道的苏定和张松，一冲出车厢就立刻紧贴在了两侧的墙根下，朱易却是威风凛凛的冲天飞起七八丈高，抖声喝道：“何方贼子暗箭伤人？不怕大汉朝的王法吗？”。
看到如此神威凛凛的朱易，叶重吓得冷汗‘唰’的冒了出来。他怪啸一声，缩成肉球一样的身体骤然弹起，比朱易上升之势更快了一倍的弹跳而起。随即一把抓住了朱易的脚踝，顺势将他狠狠的朝地下丢了下去。
朱易惊叫一声被叶重丢下了地面，叶重却是无奈何的顺着这股反震之力向上又飞了一丈多高。
就在此时，四周黑漆漆的墙头上，却是突然传来一声轻喝：“打！”。
‘砰’的一声闷响，好似一门小钢炮在叶重的耳边开炮，三根小孩子胳膊粗细，长有一丈三尺的重弩，带着刺耳的破空声朝叶重当心射了过来。
这重弩通体用钨钢锻造，沉重异常，也不知道是什么样变态的弩机，才能将它们弹射出来，而且弩箭飞行的速度，比刚才的破风锥还要快了一倍。
“闪开！”，朱易狂啸了一声，他刚刚从地上爬起，就看到三支重弩箭射向了叶重，不由得吓得魂飞天外。
叶重身体在半空中无法借力，这时候哪里还有躲闪的余地。他双眸中骤然闪过一抹冰冷如雪的血光，双手急速的在面前连连绕起了圈子。
此刻，叶重体内的元气奔涌而出，在他面前化为数十重急速旋转的无形漩涡。空气在急速旋转，发出了刺耳的风啸声，空气和空气摩擦，隐隐带起了白色的气爆圈。
三支弩箭，骤然到了叶重面前不到三尺之地。在一声爆鸣之后，三根用钨钢打造的重弩箭，突然诡异的扭成了麻花，被无形的空气漩涡一卷一旋，扭曲的重弩箭紧贴着叶重的身体掠过，远远的飞出去了小半里地。
此刻，叶重只觉一股巨大的力量当面撞来，双手好像被重锤狠狠的轰了一下，体内的元气剧烈的颤抖了一下，引得体内元气一阵大乱。在一口鲜血喷出之后，叶重便是借着重弩箭的势头朝后飞退二十几丈。
怒啸一声，叶重骨子里的那股子悍勇之气发作，他突然‘哈哈’大笑起来。一边歇斯底里的大笑着，他一边从腰间的储物戒指中掏出了两柄上好弦的破天弩。
‘嘎嘣’声中，十八支纯钢弩箭，朝刚才重弩箭射来的方向激射而去。箭矢没入黑暗，百丈外突然传来了凄厉的惨嚎声，弩箭射穿人肉体，射穿人骨头的声音是那样的刺耳，紧接着有沉闷的撞击声传来，应该是有人从墙头上摔倒在了地上。
随手将两具发射一空的穿云弩塞进储物戒指，叶重手起处，又是两具弩弓凭空出现。又是十八支纯钢弩箭射出，随后又是十八支，又是十八支。
叶重借着重弩的力道向后飞退十几丈，他居然连续激发了十二波二十四具破天弩。两百多支弩箭绵绵射出，黑暗中不时传来惨叫声和惊怒交集的咒骂声。
看到这一幕，朱易瞬间大笑了起来，随即更是大声喝道：“干得漂亮！哈哈哈！”。
这些破天弩，都是苍狼城一战从天马兽骑手中缴获，叶重看这弩弓威力极大，本着有备无患的原则，就在储物戒指中储存了一百具上好弩箭的弩弓，今夜正好派上了用场。
黑暗中用床弩，射了叶重三箭的人，根本没想到叶重会无聊到，在储物戒指中装上这么多上好弦的破天弩。他们被叶重打了个措手不及，一伙人当场死伤大半。
就在此时，一声阴恻恻的冷笑，却是从远处遥遥传来：“嘿，有点本事，不过，还是得死！”。
叶重一口元气消散，他踉跄了一下落在了地上。朱易三人急忙凑了过来和叶重会和，叶重伸手急抓，从储物戒指中抓出了几具破天弩递给了他们。黑灯瞎火的，还是用弩弓来得便利，一旦有动静，只管用弩箭射击就好。
将朱易护在正中，叶重当头，苏定和张松一左一右的护在了后面，四人用最快的速度朝小巷出口奔去。四个人都是武王境界的修为，武王元气起处，身形一起一落就是十丈左右，眼看就要冲出这条小巷。
可是那声冷笑一起，四人就觉得脚下地面骤然一抖。
长安不仅城墙高大坚固，城内街道两旁的墙壁也有玄虚。就以叶重他们所在的这条小巷而言，两侧高耸的墙壁都是用巨石搭建而成，墙壁根基下面有机括，一旦发动，则墙壁立刻向街道中倾斜倒塌。如果敌人攻入了城中，不管来多少敌军，只要他们在街道上行走，机括一旦发动，巨石塌下，哪怕是铁人都要被巨石砸扁。
那些袭击叶重一行人的幕后黑手，也不知道是什么背景来历，居然就悍然发动了这原本作为大汉朝最后一重城防的杀手锏。
四人只觉脚下一软，脚尖一个借力不到，身体朝前飞掠的速度骤然一慢。

Chapter 245: Fighting to the Death
The peaceful night in Chang'an was suddenly broken by a loud noise. After focusing his eyes with vitality, Ye Zhong also saw clearly what was shooting at him in the night.
It was dozens of fingers thick and more than a foot long. It was completely black and treated with anti-reflective treatment, and it was a streamlined three-sided wind-breaking cone. This strange-shaped wind-breaking cone is well-designed, and the craftsmanship of its creation is extremely high. The wind-breaking cone shot with a powerful machine gun is extremely fast, and it actually makes no sound when flying.
If he hadn't entered the realm of King Wu and already had preliminary spiritual consciousness, Ye Zhong wouldn't have noticed the approach of this thing at all.
"Hey" he breathed out, his vitality came out of his body, and a layer of flexible and dense Gang Qi covered his whole body. Ye Zhong took out two palms and faced several wind-breaking cones that were less than ten feet away from him. The Shattering Mountain Palm was activated instantly, an invisible vortex of air swept out, and a strange wind howl immediately sounded in the air.
The sound of cracking silk was heard, and the two vortexes of energy that Ye Zhong shot were easily pierced by the wind-breaking cones. The protective energy that he released about a foot outside his body was easily broken by the wind-breaking cones. Not only that, the wind-breaking cone went against Ye Zhong's energy, its speed suddenly increased by 30%, and it shot down as fast as lightning.
"This thing can break Gang Qi!", the blood in his eyes swirled, and Ye Zhong suddenly saw clearly the small talisman "Breaking Wind Talisman" carved on the wind-breaking cone. This was originally used on elements such as flying swords. It is specially used to break the natural strong wind at high altitudes and increase the flying speed of flying swords. It is also used to protect warriors' Gang Qi, and it has a miraculous effect.
At this moment, Ye Zhong could clearly see the faint black light at the tips of these wind-breaking cones. The sharpest tip in front of the wind-breaking cone is actually made of the rare "underworld iron". This thousand-year-old dark iron is a strange metal that can only be produced by absorbing hundreds of years of underground Yin Qi. It is also designed to break the warrior's Qi.
Ye Zhong screamed strangely, but Ye Zhong still dared to resist. Then he saw Ye Zhong holding his head, his body suddenly shrunk, and turned into a meat ball less than two feet in size. With a gust of wind, Ye Zhong rolled close to the ground and rolled out. Intensive 'chichi' sounds continued to sound, and dozens of wind-breaking cones were shot onto the ground close to Ye Zhong's body, shooting out dozens of bottomless holes on the ground.
After turning around, Ye Zhong rushed to the carriage where Zhu Yi and the others were sitting, and kicked the carriage towards the entrance of the alley.
A huge burst of vitality erupted, and the heavy carriage retreated more than ten feet with a roar. Nearly a hundred wind-breaking cones shot down in confusion, and a large number of small holes were shot out on the ground. With a loud noise, the carriage exploded, and Zhu Yi, Su Ding, and Zhang Song rushed out of the shattered carriage.
The experienced Su Ding and Zhang Song rushed out of the carriage and immediately clung to the walls on both sides. Zhu Yi flew majestically into the sky seven to eight feet high and shouted with a trembling voice: "Where can a traitor hurt someone with a secret arrow? Aren't you afraid of the laws of the Han Dynasty?"
Seeing such a majestic Zhu Yi, Ye Chong was so frightened that he broke out in a cold sweat. He let out a strange roar, and his body, shrunk into a meat ball, suddenly bounced up, twice as fast as Zhu Yi's ascent. Then he grabbed Zhu Yi's ankle and threw him to the ground.
Zhu Yi screamed and was thrown to the ground by Ye Zhong, but Ye Zhong helplessly followed the force of the shock and flew upwards more than a foot high.
At this moment, a soft shout came from the surrounding dark walls: "Hit!".
There was a muffled sound of 'bang', like a small steel cannon firing in Ye Zhong's ear. Three heavy crossbows, as thick as a child's arm and one foot or three feet long, shot towards Ye Zhong cautiously with a harsh sound of breaking through the air.
This heavy crossbow is made of tungsten steel and is extremely heavy. It is unknown what kind of abnormal crossbow machine can eject them, and the speed of the crossbow arrows is twice as fast as the wind-breaking cone just now.
"Get out of the way!" Zhu Yi screamed wildly. As soon as he got up from the ground, he saw three heavy crossbow arrows shooting at Ye Chong, and he couldn't help but be frightened out of his wits.
Ye Zhong's body was unable to use any force in mid-air, so there was no room for dodge at this time. A flash of blood as cold as snow suddenly flashed in his eyes, and his hands quickly circled in front of him.
At this moment, the vitality in Ye Zhong's body surged out and turned into dozens of rapidly rotating invisible whirlpools in front of him. The air was spinning rapidly, making a harsh whistling sound. The friction between the air and the air caused a faint white air explosion ring.
Three crossbow arrows suddenly arrived less than three feet in front of Ye Zhong. After a loud explosion, three heavy crossbow arrows made of tungsten steel suddenly twisted into twists and were swirled by the invisible vortex of air. The twisted heavy crossbow arrows flew close to Ye Zhong's body and flew out for less than half a mile.
At this moment, Ye Zhong felt a huge force hitting his face, his hands seemed to have been hit hard by a heavy hammer, and the energy in his body trembled violently, causing a chaos in the energy in his body. After a mouthful of blood spurted out, Ye Zhong used the momentum of the heavy crossbow arrow to fly back more than twenty feet.
With an angry roar, the bravery in Ye Zhong's bones broke out, and he suddenly burst out laughing. While laughing hysterically, he took out two strung Sky-breaking Crossbows from the storage ring around his waist.
With a 'crack' sound, eighteen pure steel crossbow arrows shot towards the direction where the heavy crossbow arrows had just been fired. The arrow sank into the darkness, and a shrill howl suddenly came from a hundred feet away. The sound of the crossbow arrow piercing human flesh and bones was so harsh, and then there was a dull impact sound. It must be that someone fell from the wall to the ground.
He casually stuffed the two fully-fired Cloud-Piercing Crossbows into the storage ring. Where Ye Zhong raised his hands, two more crossbows appeared out of thin air. Eighteen more pure steel crossbow arrows were shot out, followed by eighteen more, and then eighteen more.
Ye Zhong used the power of the heavy crossbow to fly back more than ten feet. He actually activated twelve waves of twenty-four sky-breaking crossbows in succession. More than two hundred crossbow arrows were fired continuously, and screams and curses mixed with shock and anger were heard from time to time in the darkness.
Seeing this scene, Zhu Yi burst out laughing instantly, and then shouted loudly: "Well done! Hahaha!".
These sky-breaking crossbows were all captured from the Pegasus beast riders in the first battle in Canglang City. Ye Zhong saw that these crossbows were extremely powerful, and based on the principle of being prepared, he stored a hundred crossbows with good crossbows in the storage ring, which came in handy tonight.
The person who shot three arrows at Ye Zhong with a bed crossbow in the dark never thought that Ye Zhong would be so bored that he would put so many well-stringed sky-breaking crossbows in his storage ring. They were caught off guard by Ye Zhong, and most of the group were killed or injured on the spot.
At this moment, a sinister sneer came from afar: "Hey, I have some skills, but I still have to die!".
Ye Zhong's energy dissipated in a breath, and he stumbled and fell to the ground. Zhu Yi and the others hurriedly came over to meet Ye Zhong. Ye Zhong reached out and grabbed several sky-breaking crossbows from the storage ring and handed them to them. If you are trying to make a fool of yourself, it is more convenient to use a crossbow. Once there is any movement, just use the crossbow arrows to shoot.
Protecting Zhu Yi in the middle, Ye Zhong at the head, Su Ding and Zhang Song on the left and right behind, the four of them ran towards the exit of the alley as fast as possible. The four of them are all at the level of King Wu. The height of King Wu's energy is about ten feet, and they are about to rush out of this alley.
But with that sneer, the four of them felt the ground beneath their feet suddenly shake.
Not only is the city wall of Chang'an tall and strong, the walls on both sides of the streets in the city also have mysterious features. As far as the alley where Ye Zhong and the others are located, the towering walls on both sides are made of huge stones. There are structures underneath the wall foundation. Once activated, the wall will immediately tilt toward the street and collapse. If the enemy invades the city, no matter how many enemy troops come, as long as they are walking on the streets, once the machine is activated, the boulders will collapse, and even an iron man will be crushed by the boulders.
The masterminds behind the attack on Ye Zhong and his party didn't know what their background was, but they brazenly launched this killer weapon that was originally the last layer of city defense in the Han Dynasty.
The four of them felt that their feet were weak, their toes were unable to use any force, and the speed of their bodies flying forward suddenly slowed down.
title_en: Chapter 345: Fight to the death Chapter 344: Attack in the dark night
